custody_model: Current Phemex Earn terms state that subscribed Earn Assets are not segregated from other users' assets and may be commingled with assets belonging to Phemex and affiliates. Redemption returns the same value/type under the product terms rather than necessarily the identical deposited units.
yield_source: Current Phemex terms permit Earn Assets to be used for operating purposes including loans to users/affiliates and on-chain staking. Historical Phemex materials also described funding-arbitrage strategies. CYA does not infer one fixed yield source for every Savings asset or period.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized-platform custody, non-segregation and commingling, borrower/default and staking exposure, liquidity constraints, variable rewards, changing product availability and the possibility that some or all Earn Assets may not be returned in extreme circumstances.

custody_model: Current WhiteBIT terms define Crypto Lending as the user lending digital assets to WhiteBIT under an available plan. The reviewed terms do not support treating the lent assets as a bank deposit, regulated savings product, segregated trust asset or universally risk-free custody arrangement.
yield_source: Income is generated under lending plans provided by WhiteBIT, with rates, terms and asset limits varying by plan. Fixed and flexible plans have distinct accrual and redemption mechanics, and some third-party proposals can also appear in the broader Crypto Lending section but are outside this canonical product identity.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized-platform credit and operational exposure, digital-asset price volatility, changing lending rates, liquidity/service restrictions, regulatory limitations and plan-specific early-withdrawal or payout conditions. Marketing statements about asset security or principal treatment are not generalized beyond applicable terms.
